questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $1.6M in NY's 17th District House race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is offense.

questions.prompt: A super PAC airs a $1,000 ad on Oct. 20. How fast must it tell the FEC?
questions.why: From Oct. 15 to Nov. 1, independent expenditures of $1,000 or more must be reported within 24 hours.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
CHC BOLD PAC (an outside group) has spent $786K in NM's 2nd District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Democrat or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: AMERICAN MISSION (a super PAC) has spent $504K in the SC Senate race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Republican or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: In the GA Senate race, outside money favors Republicans by $3.4M. Whose nominee has raised more?
questions.why: Outside money and candidate money point opposite ways here: the Democrat leads fundraising by $69.9M.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
Groups helping Republicans have spent $41.7M in the ME Senate race. Are Republicans playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Republicans here is defense.

questions.prompt: What starts the clock on a 24- or 48-hour spending report?
questions.why: The reporting clock starts on the dissemination date, when the ad first reaches the public.

questions.prompt: In the final 60 days, who pays less for the same TV spot?
questions.why: Stations must sell candidates airtime at the lowest unit charge. Outside groups pay market rates, which climb near Election Day.
